family: Actual uniform Boolean F_h priority gate, with h a signed product of point defects; local a-child G_epsilon(x,z)=epsilon at x=0 and h(z) at x=1.
local_main_domain: Queried widths w=2,3,4,5; spectator types none, width2 point, width3 point, width1 character, width2 point times width1 character; epsilon=+1,-1 and core sign=+1,-1. Exactly 80 actual local parents; both physical outcomes in every case.
pilot_domain: w=3; spectator none,width2 point,width1 character; both epsilon and core signs. Exactly 12 parents.
root_main_domain: (m,r)=(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2); two policies each. Exactly eight actual F roots/policies. Query b; in b1 query a, actually reset both a children to 5/6 factor laws; then query the first data coordinate on both a children or only a=0. Actually reset only its queried factor to 4/5 and preserve the paid spectator laws. Keep b0 and both children of every query.
symmetry: No exhaustive Boolean-function or symmetry-class claim. Chosen coordinate is the first of a point factor, justified for the analytic all-coordinate theorem by permutation invariance within that factor; all declared controller/core signs are explicitly tested.
arithmetic: Integer FWHT for main actual amplitudes; Fraction references, kernels, normalizers, likelihood identities. KL as exact rational linear combinations of prime logarithms. Signs use 28-term atanh log intervals with proved geometric tail and directed dyadic rounding at 2^-130. Independent audit uses literal Walsh sums on widths2..4 and a width2 spectator (12 parents for two epsilons and two core signs).
compute_admission: All jobs estimated below300MB; no Lean or heavy job is planned. Foreground synchronous commands only; no GPU.
